name: Wrike
description: Access your Wrike workspace directly from Claude to plan, prioritise, update and track work. Turn chats into projects, tasks, and timelines your team can see and execute. Pull in meeting notes, assign owners, set due dates — all without switching tools. Keep your team moving forward, right from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wrike to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wrike to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wrike.com/app/mcp/stream. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wrike MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wrike lists 17 MCP tools, including create_item_comment, get_item_comments, get_item_details, get_my_inbox, get_users, search_customitemtypes, search_item_customfields, search_items, search_users, search_workflows, get_approvals, and search_approvals.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wrike?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wrike in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Wrike requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wrike is developed by Wrike. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
